board.note: 10x10 board with two 2x2 impassable lakes in the center. Piece positions are public but ranks are hidden until combat.

captured.note: Captured pieces for each player (pieces the opponent has lost).

miner.note: Miners can defuse (capture) Bombs instead of being destroyed by them.

scout.note: Scouts can move any number of unoccupied cells in a straight orthogonal line.

spy.note: The Spy defeats the Marshal only when the Spy initiates the attack.

bomb.note: Bombs are immobile. Any piece attacking a Bomb is destroyed, except Miners which defuse the Bomb.

flag.note: The Flag is immobile. Capturing the opponent Flag wins the game.

phases.name: setup
phases.ends_when: both players have placed all 40 pieces
phases.note: Each player places all 40 pieces on their own half of the board (rows 0-3 for red, rows 6-9 for blue). Placement is hidden from the opponent.

phases.name: play
phases.ends_when: flag captured or player cannot move

constraints: red places on rows 0-3, blue places on rows 6-9
each piece type placed exactly the correct count
no cell occupied by more than one piece
lake cells are not valid placement targets
all 40 pieces must be placed before play begins
only movable pieces (not Bomb or Flag) may move
movement is orthogonal only (no diagonal)
standard pieces move exactly 1 cell
scouts may slide any number of unoccupied cells in a straight orthogonal line
pieces cannot enter or cross lake cells
pieces cannot enter cells occupied by friendly pieces
moving into a cell occupied by an enemy piece initiates combat

combat.definition: Combat resolution when a piece attacks an enemy piece
combat.server_resolves: reveal both ranks; higher rank wins (attacker wins ties is wrong: both removed on tie); special: Spy attacking Marshal wins; Miner attacking Bomb wins; any non-Miner attacking Bomb is destroyed; losing piece is removed to captured zone
constraints: higher rank wins, lower rank is captured
equal ranks: both pieces are removed
Spy defeats Marshal only when Spy is the attacker
Miner defeats Bomb (defuses it)
any non-Miner attacking a Bomb is destroyed by the Bomb
Bomb remains in place after destroying an attacker (unless attacked by Miner)

two_square_rule.definition: A piece cannot move back and forth between two cells more than a limited number of consecutive times
two_square_rule.constraint: a piece may not move between the same two squares more than 3 times consecutively

constraints: a player can see positions of all pieces but only ranks of own pieces
opponent piece ranks are hidden until combat occurs
when combat occurs, both ranks are revealed to both players
captured pieces and their ranks are public information

end_conditions.condition: current player has no legal moves (all movable pieces eliminated or blocked)
end_conditions.name: no_legal_moves
